== Historical card identities and deck-table verification (Story 386) ==
The [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-retro-world-championship-ls-zach-stenerson-rendezvous-point/ published Retro decklist] and [[Media:26RWC Stenerson LS Rendezvous Point.txt|wiki-hosted XML download]] each contain 60 cards. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261114034750/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2026-retro-world-championship-ls-zach-stenerson-rendezvous-point.html Players Committee decklist].
The article retains those quantities and the original download bytes (SHA-256 <code>7d0a4440e0422174fac1a04c1ec28b6c1cd6ffafafd019afc9bc322aaea79a8a</code>). The original forum ZIP has not been independently byte-verified.

Every linked card family was compared with the XML blueprint code. Existing Decipher printed articles were retained for the [[Premiere - Death Star II]] format; an unqualified XML code was not used to substitute a Modern Players Committee erratum. All 45 deck rows have card-image hovers bound to the same linked historical article. Card-type blocks and their contents are alphabetical, with whole blocks balanced between the columns.
